engine.title: Inside the Analysis Engine
engine.subtitle: 11 analysis families, scientific weighting, transparent decisions
engine.methodologyBody: Each indicator produces a normalized score between -1 and +1; scores combine with explicit weights into a composite between -100 and +100. Above +20 means BUY, below -20 means SELL, in between means WAIT. Entry and stop levels are ATR-based.
engine.securityTitle: Security is priority one, two and three
engine.securityBody: Wallet-signature auth (SIWE), fully on-chain payment verification via the official Abstract RPC, HMAC-signed sessions, rate limiting, Zod input validation, and zero client trust.
engine.dataBody: Live price from DexScreener, historical data from CoinGecko — both public, no API keys. All computation is server-side and reproducible.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Just connect your Abstract wallet (AGW) and sign the login message. No email or password needed.
faq.a2: You transfer PENGU from your wallet to the treasury address; the system automatically verifies the transaction on-chain and activates your access.
faq.a3: No. This is the output of technical-analysis algorithms on real data, for informational purposes only. Trade at your own risk.
faq.a4: Abstract is an Ethereum L2 with negligible fees — the official home of the Pudgy Penguins ecosystem and the PENGU token. Where penguins live.
faq.a5: Yes! Signing up and browsing (live market, track record, dashboard) is completely free. To read signal content you need an access pass — from 10 PENGU for one day up to lifetime, with stepped discounts capped at 30%.
faq.a6: No. Payments are plain PENGU token transfers to the treasury address — no approvals, no permanent wallet access. Everything is verified fully on-chain.
